name: Flieber
summary: Flieber is collaborative AI for multichannel commerce brands: it prepares inventory, purchasing, pricing and allocation decisions for the brand's team to approve and carries them out afterward. Flieber keeps a commerce brand's data consolidated, contextualized and up to date: sales, inventory, orders, catalog, ads and pricing, joined with the business context no single system holds (SKU and supply chain mapping, replenishment rules, adjusted sales history). On top of that data it forecasts demand at SKU level, simulates the effect of purchasing, pricing, advertising and allocation decisions on inventory, revenue, margin and cash, and pushes approved decisions to ERPs, marketplaces, 3PLs and suppliers, following approval rules the brand sets. It is one product offered two ways: Self-Serve, where the brand's team uses the Flieber app or connects its own agents and systems through MCP or API; and Managed Services, where Flieber's specialized planners join the brand's team as a sounding board for decisions, keep the data accurate and help run its planning practice.
product_model: one product, offered as Self-Serve or Managed Services

offers.name: Flieber Self-Serve

Wants a ready-made app, or builds its own reports, workflows or agents
Has a complex operation but an in-house data or AI team

options.name: Data layer only

Wants consolidated, contextualized commerce data through MCP or API without the planning app

offers.name: Flieber Managed Services

features.name: Connect your sales channels and inventory
features.description: Flieber connects to pretty much any system through native and assisted integrations, plus MCP and API. Native integrations work during the free trial; assisted integrations are set up by Flieber's team on a paid plan.

features.name: Data health
features.description: Checks your account for issues, gaps and anomalies, applies the fixes it can and flags the ones that need a person.

features.name: Cross-channel SKU mapping
features.description: Links listings and SKUs across channels to one master product, so sales consolidate for planning. Automatic matching, plus bulk catalog import and export.

features.name: Sales order routing
features.description: Route sales orders from any store to the regions or warehouses you choose, so one Shopify account can be planned as several regional markets.

features.name: Kits, bundles and components
features.description: Turns demand for bundles into component requirements. Buy at component level and transfer inventory as finished products.

features.name: Product configuration and classification
features.description: Product status, custom attributes, costs, prices and packaging units. ABCD classification ranks products by sales, units or profit using your thresholds.

features.name: Supply chain map
features.description: Suppliers, warehouses, 3PLs and channels, with fulfillment and fallback locations, transfer routes, production and transit lead times and ordering cadence.

features.name: Sales history adjusted for anomalies
features.description: Corrects history distorted by stockouts, spikes and promotions, and shows actual sales next to the adjusted demand used for forecasting.

features.name: Inventory history and balances
features.description: Snapshots and balances across every connected location, including inbound and in-transit stock.

features.name: Reports and dashboards
features.description: Report sales by product and channel, inventory history and value, projected revenue and forecast performance, and build your own dashboards with live alerts and scheduled delivery.

features.name: Uploads and Google Sheets
features.description: Bulk updates to catalog, forecasts, shipments, bundles and wholesale data through CSV files or Google Sheets, with a preview before anything is saved.

features.name: Organizations and users
features.description: Manage several organizations from one place, with unlimited users on every plan and Admin and Member roles.

features.name: AI demand forecasts
features.description: Product and channel level forecasts across marketplaces, DTC and wholesale, built from adjusted history and seasonality. 36% more accurate than our previous portfolio of 16 forecasting models, tested on a random sample of 46,000 products. Built with Nixtla, the team behind the TimeGPT forecasting model.

features.name: Forecast overrides and uploads
features.description: Import your own forecasts, or adjust at SKU, store, channel or group level, including planned promotions and events.

features.name: Targets and new products
features.description: Apply growth percentages, unit targets or revenue targets across selected products. Forecast new products from similar ones or from a manual curve.

features.name: Forecast accuracy and bias
features.description: Error and bias metrics, with monthly forecast versions saved so past predictions can be compared with what actually sold. Forecast value added reports on request.

features.name: Wholesale forecast reconciliation
features.description: Finds wholesale demand parked on dates that passed without a sale and suggests where to move it. On request.

features.name: Inventory projections
features.description: Stock by product, channel and location from on-hand, inbound and forecast demand, with days of cover and consolidated warehouse needs.

features.name: Stockouts, overstock and lost sales
features.description: Projected stockout dates, products below safety stock, excess inventory and the sales lost to unavailable stock or late shipments.

features.name: Backorders and preorders
features.description: Counts accumulated backorder demand in inventory and replenishment calculations, with settings by channel, and plans for products sold before they arrive.

features.name: Purchase and transfer recommendations
features.description: What to order or transfer, how much and when, by product and location, including replenishment from warehouses or 3PLs to fulfillment locations such as FBA.

features.name: Planning parameters
features.description: Safety stock, target days of cover, overstock thresholds, lead times and order frequency, with rules for products, categories and channels.

features.name: Order and shipping constraints
features.description: Minimum order quantities and supplier constraints, container planning and rounding to case packs, cartons or pallets.

features.name: Decision simulations
features.description: Test changes to order quantities, demand, arrival dates or lead times and see the effect on inventory, revenue, margin and cash before anything is committed.

features.name: Multi-month purchase planning
features.description: Splits a long buying horizon into seasonally weighted purchase orders, with cartons, MOQs and lead times applied and periods already covered by stock left at zero.

features.name: AI order-quantity adjustments
features.description: Rebalances planned quantities across destinations and fits orders to container capacity, budget and cash-flow limits, following notes you write in plain language.

features.name: Saved plans and purchase orders
features.description: Replenishment plans by supplier and date, with costs. Create and track POs, group them under master POs and record placed-order status.

features.name: Purchase orders to suppliers
features.description: Sends each PO straight into the supplier's system or as an email, CSV file or Google Sheet in the supplier's own format, with products identified by SKU or product name.

features.name: Purchase orders to ERPs
features.description: Pushes approved POs into NetSuite or light ERPs such as Cin7 and Brightpearl.

features.name: Inbound shipments in Amazon and 3PLs
features.description: Creates inbound shipments in Amazon and in connected 3PL and warehouse systems from an approved plan.

features.name: Inbound shipment tracking
features.description: Follows POs and shipments through delivery, with manual entry, Google Sheets sync and automatic import of connected inbound shipments such as Amazon FBA.

features.name: Alerts and scheduled reports
features.description: Scheduled checks for stockout risk, excess inventory and orders due, delivered by email, Slack, Microsoft Teams or Google Sheets.

features.name: Custom workflows and agents
features.description: Describe a recurring job in plain language and Flieber runs it on schedule, across its own data and your connected apps.

features.name: Actions in other systems
features.description: Flieber is also an MCP client, so it can connect to any system with an MCP server and act where the decision lands: adjust an ad campaign, update a price, confirm with a supplier.

features.name: Flieber app
features.description: Planning screens, saved views, dashboards and exports to CSV.

features.name: Ask in plain language
features.description: Ask questions about your data and get answers, tables, charts and dashboards. Save reports, refresh them and keep the conversation going.

features.name: Slack
features.description: Ask questions and receive alerts in Slack.

features.name: Google Sheets add-on
features.description: Pulls Flieber data into your own sheets and refreshes it on a schedule.

features.name: MCP server
features.description: Connect Claude, Cursor or your own agents. Requests go to Flieber's own agent (Flieber Studio), which answers questions and carries out the same actions as the app, following your approval rules. Answers typically take 30 seconds to 5 minutes. Full action list in the MCP docs (customer login required).

features.name: MCP client and connected apps
features.description: Flieber connects out to Gmail, Outlook, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Sheets, OneDrive, Notion, Airtable, Meta Ads, Google Ads and NetSuite, and to any other system with an MCP server.

features.name: Public API
features.description: Programmatic access to Flieber data for your own systems. Details in the MCP docs (customer login required).

Wants a ready-made app, or builds its own reports, workflows or agents
Has a complex operation but an in-house data or AI team

data_handling.ownership: your data stays yours and is never sold or shared
data_handling.encryption_in_transit: HTTPS only, with TLS 1.2 or higher, for all external traffic and for internal database and cache connections
data_handling.encryption_at_rest: AES-256 through AWS KMS for all customer data, including databases, backups, cache and file storage
data_handling.marketplace_connections: Amazon and Shopify connect through OAuth; Flieber never sees marketplace passwords, only revocable access tokens, encrypted with a dedicated AWS KMS key in AWS Secrets Manager
data_handling.passwords_and_secrets: sign-in through Clerk, so no user passwords are stored; API tokens stored only as hashes; application secrets in AWS Secrets Manager, never in code
data_handling.access: Admin (admin tools) and Member (operational tools only); single sign-on with Google and Microsoft
data_handling.ai_models: several providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI and xAI; data reaches a model only when a request requires it; Flieber does not train on customer data and its providers are set up not to
data_handling.changes_to_your_systems: every change Flieber makes to your systems follows approval rules you set; by default, every change requires approval
data_handling.retention_and_deletion: as set out in the Privacy Policy and Service Agreement
